steps.name: create-branch
steps.description: Create task/t0091_morphology_extended_nsga2_v1 branch from main and plan the step list.

steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify all 10 dependencies (t0024, t0078, t0080, t0081, t0083, t0086, t0088, t0090, t0092, t0093) are completed.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the mandatory task folder structure: code/, plan/, research/, results/, assets/answer/, assets/predictions/, corrections/, intervention/, logs/.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review NSGA-II / DSGC morphology / biological-plausibility papers in the corpus to inform the joint 68-d optimisation design.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Search for recent NSGA-II in high-d biology, mixed integer-real handling in pymoo, and DSGC morphology priors not in the existing corpus.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review code, libraries, and assets from t0078, t0080, t0081, t0083, t0086, t0088, t0090, t0092, t0093: NSGA-II driver, biological scorecard, cluster framework, t0092 patched generator, t0093 correction overlay.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Synthesise research outputs and the existing task_description.md into plan/plan.md with all 11 mandatory sections and a per-cell evaluation calling generate_fixed_morphology.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision Vast.ai EPYC 7B13 64-core CPU instance for the joint 68-d NSGA-II run; verify SSH and environment.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Build 5-anchor warm-start population (pop 96); run joint 68-d NSGA-II for up to 8 generations with adaptive HV-plateau stop and $4.00 cost watchdog; download Pareto archive.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy Vast.ai instance; finalise costs.json and remote_machines_used.json.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Out-of-the-box analysis on the 68-d Pareto: anchor-tracking patterns, asymmetry-direction bias, biological-plausibility surface, alternative interpretations.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, remote_machines_used.json, charts; predictions asset for 68-d Pareto cells.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare 68-d Pareto-front bio-plausibility distribution to t0086 priors (Sivyer 2013 NMDA, Stuart 1999 NaP, GABA spatial gradient) and Schachter 2010 / Trenholm 2013 / Briggman 2011 morphology data.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Formulate follow-up suggestions: continued optimisation, real-cell library option, post-t0091 validation, anchor-direction-specific deep-dives.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators; capture session transcripts; finalise task.json status to completed; PR and merge.
